---
title: Fuel-analysis specification
---

This is a pre-analysis specification for publication development. It records
the existing pipeline and proposed decisions; it does not modify data or
generate publication results.

## Existing thesis-era handling to preserve as a reference

`analysis/analysis/fuel_modeling_round_3.qmd` labels and models 1-hour,
10-hour, 100-hour, 1,000-hour, duff-and-litter, vegetation, and vegetation
difference classes. Duff and litter are combined as `dufflitter`. The
post-precommercial-thinning workflow excludes `dufflitter` because the existing
script notes that the collected litter-depth information is not suitable for its
load equation. The workflow also converts nonpositive `veg_diff` values to zero
before fitting the post-treatment models.

These choices define the historical thesis analysis. They must remain
reproducible and must not be overwritten.

## Publication decisions to make before coding

1. Identify exactly which raw measurement fields can support separate reporting
   of duff, litter, live vegetation, and each dead-fuel time-lag class at each
   measurement phase.
2. Produce phase-specific reference estimates and a clearly defined pre/post-PCT
   contrast. Retain modeled treatment estimates or comparisons where they
   clarify overstory-retention or PCT-management implications.
3. Specify how pre- and post-precommercial-thinning observations will be
   presented as distinct reference phases and how the PCT-associated contrast
   will be estimated. Confirm whether the sampling design supports a paired
   change analysis before describing the contrast as a causal PCT effect.
4. Define how zero values, missing values, and any negative derived differences
   will be handled, including sensitivity checks where that choice could affect
   interpretation.
5. Select a small set of units, component definitions, and uncertainty measures
   suitable for transparent reuse across silvicultural, fuels, fire, and
   potential modeling applications.

## Required publication outputs

- A data dictionary for each published fuel component and its units.
- A reproducible publication-specific derived dataset in
  `analysis/outputs/publication/data/`.
- A written model or summary specification in
  `analysis/scripts/publication/`.
- Main-text phase-comparison figure/table and supplemental component detail,
  both stored under `analysis/outputs/publication/`.
- A documented estimand and uncertainty calculation for the PCT-associated
  contrast, including any limits on causal interpretation.
- A comparison note describing any material difference between thesis-era and
  publication-era component definitions or estimates.

## Guardrails

- Do not modify `analysis/analysis/fuel_modeling_round_3.qmd` or overwrite
  `analysis/fuel_modeling_round_3.rda`.
- Do not alter raw data in `data/`.
- Record analytical changes in `publication/editorial-log.qmd` before they are
  used in manuscript text.
